title: Dress the cut from the template kit
text: Every day uses the same nine pieces: the hook stack (dim 50, black tone + vignette, zoom, film damage, red-blue glitch, a 1-2 frame invert), the `SFX_โหนกระแส` sting, the BGM bed on its 56.48 s loop grid, the end stack and `CG_END LOGO`; headline cards are After Effects Linked Comps. Weakened: film damage is not a clean lifted-footage marker; the BGM bed is a daily-cut rule (EP.162/167 have none).
